item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Kokuchou
  • 発売日: 2013-06-21
  • スコア: 6.2299999999999995/10 (78 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 雨音スイッチ ～やまない雨と病んだ彼女そして俺～
  • 英語名: Amane Switch Yamanai Ame to Yanda Kanojo Soshite Ore

别名

  • 雨音スイッチ

あらすじ

Shinji Mizushima leads a normal life with average athletic and academic performance before becoming acquainted with a mysterious girl named Amane Satonaka.

Shortly after Amane transfers to Shuei Academy, Shinji finds himself drawn to her when he sees her standing outside in the rain without an umbrella, humming a melancholic melody to herself. The sight of her figure drenched in the downpour of rain is so beautiful it seems otherworldly to him. In that moment, her existence becomes transcendent.

item.description:

  • 発売日: 2011-06-24

  • 日本語名: 牝辱の穴ウメ ～学園報復戦争～
  • 英語名: Mejoku no Anaume Gakuen Houfuku Sensou

あらすじ

The setting is a boarding school deep hidden in the mountainside completely isolated from the rest of civilization.

As this school follows a policy to treat scholarship students much more favourably than their average students, a considerable rift has formed between these two groups.

Inside the school, a student who got brutally raped and who was left in a horrific state is being discovered.
